payload.text: One binary: every command the shell pplr offered (the 30 in recon section 4) is served by the Rust `pplr` with the same arguments and flags, except `email` and `contact log --email`, which are on hold by hv's ruling of 2026-11-02 until hv decides how pplr reads mail. No `bin/pplr*` script, `lib/engine.sh` or run-time build remains.
